concept.ai-memory.def: Saving what matters to a store outside the context window and recalling it when needed, so an assistant can remember across turns even though each model call starts fresh.
concept.ai-working-memory.def: The context the model reads right now - the scratchpad for the task in hand, and the first thing to vanish as the chat rolls on.
concept.ai-episodic-memory.def: The store of what happened before - past turns and events, each tied to a time, like the assistant's diary.
concept.ai-semantic-memory.def: The store of what stays true with no date attached - facts about the world or about you.
concept.ai-procedural-memory.def: The store of how to do things - the routines and steps the assistant follows to act.
